text.en: Why is the answer asked for in a structured (JSON) form?

tr: Birden fazla bilgiyi programın aramadan okuyabilmesi için
en: So that the program can read several pieces of information without searching

explanation.tr: Serbest metinde her cevapta arama gerekir.
explanation.en: Free text needs a search in every answer.

text.en: What is written in a schema?

tr: Alanların adı, türü ve izin verilen değerleri
en: The fields' names, types and allowed values

explanation.en: In the lesson category, urgent and order_id.

text.tr: Şemayı zorlayan bir API ayarı neyi garanti eder?
text.en: What does an API setting that enforces the schema guarantee?

tr: Yalnızca biçimi; değerin doğru seçildiğini değil
en: Only the form; not that the value was chosen correctly

explanation.en: The program still checks whether the category is right.

text.tr: Derste altı örnek yanıtın kaçı ayrıştırıldı?
text.en: How many of the six example replies were parsed in the lesson?

explanation.tr: Tek tırnaklı ve kesilmiş olanlar ayrıştırılamadı.
explanation.en: The single-quoted and the cut-off ones could not be parsed.

text.en: Which three ways did the parser try?

tr: Metnin kendisi, kod bloğu atılmış hâli, ilk `{` ile son `}` arası
en: The text itself, without the code block, between the first `{` and the last `}`

explanation.en: Harmless additions are cleaned.

text.tr: "Sure! Here is the JSON:" ile başlayan cevap hangi yolla ayrıştırıldı?
text.en: Which way parsed the answer starting with "Sure! Here is the JSON:"?

en: Between the first `{` and the last `}`

explanation.en: The sentence in front was dropped.

text.tr: Tek tırnaklı Python sözlüğü gibi cevapla ne yapmak daha temizdir?
text.en: What is cleaner to do with an answer written like a single-quoted Python dictionary?

explanation.tr: Kurtarmaya çalışınca hangi biçimlerin kabul edildiği belirsizleşir.
explanation.en: Rescuing it makes it unclear which forms are accepted.

text.tr: Kesilmiş bir JSON'un sebebi çoğu zaman nedir?
text.en: What is usually the cause of a cut-off JSON?

en: `max_tokens` not being enough for the answer

explanation.en: `finish_reason` is `length`.

text.tr: Kesilmiş JSON'da ilk bakılacak şey nedir?
text.en: What is the first thing to look at with a cut-off JSON?

explanation.en: If it is `length`, `max_tokens` is raised.

text.en: Is every parsed JSON right?

en: No; it must be validated against the schema

explanation.tr: Beşinci cevap geçerli JSON'du ama üç şema hatası vardı.
explanation.en: The fifth answer was valid JSON but had three schema errors.

text.en: Which was not one of the errors in the fifth answer?

en: A category not in the list
An order number in the wrong form

explanation.en: The field was there but its value was `delivery`.

text.en: How many of the six answers could be used in the lesson?

explanation.en: One of the four parsed ones did not fit the schema.

text.en: How was the `order_id` rule checked?

explanation.en: `fullmatch` wants the whole text to match the pattern.

text.en: Why was `isinstance(..., bool)` used for the `urgent` field?

tr: "yes" gibi metinler de doğru görünmesin diye; yalnızca true/false kabul
en: So that texts such as "yes" do not look right; only true/false are accepted

explanation.en: In JSON `true` arrives in Python as `True`.

text.tr: Hata mesajları neden okunur cümleler olarak yazıldı?
text.en: Why were the error messages written as readable sentences?

en: Because they will be sent back to the model
Because they will be shown to the user

explanation.en: The model sees what it did wrong.

text.en: What does the repair loop do?

tr: Geçersiz cevabı ve hata listesini sohbete ekleyip yeniden sorar
en: Adds the invalid answer and the error list to the conversation and asks again
Fixes the answer with a guess

explanation.tr: Model kendi cevabını ve hatayı görür.
explanation.en: The model sees its own answer and the error.

text.en: Why is the repair loop limited?

tr: Her deneme daha çok token gönderir ve sonsuza kadar sürebilir
en: Every try sends more tokens and it could go on forever

explanation.en: When the limit is reached, a person or `needs_review`.

text.tr: Derste onarımla ikinci çağrının giren token'ı ne oldu?
text.en: What happened to the second call's input tokens in the lesson's repair?

explanation.tr: İlk soru, yanlış cevap ve hata mesajı birlikte gitti.
explanation.en: The first question, the wrong answer and the error message went together.

text.tr: Derste geçerli cevap kaçıncı denemede geldi?
text.en: On which try did a valid answer come in the lesson?

explanation.tr: Senaryoda önce geçersiz, sonra geçerli cevap vardı.
explanation.en: The script had an invalid answer first, then a valid one.

text.tr: Geçersiz cevapları azaltmanın asıl yolu nedir?
text.en: What is the real way to reduce invalid answers?

tr: Talimatı ve örnekleri iyileştirmek; onarımı kalan durumlar için kullanmak
en: Improving the instruction and examples; using the repair for the remaining cases

explanation.en: The repair is expensive.

text.en: Why is the rule "`null` if unknown" written?

en: Otherwise the model may make up a value

explanation.tr: Boş değer kuralı da şemanın parçasıdır.
explanation.en: The empty-value rule is part of the schema too.

text.en: What should not be written in an error message?

tr: Kişisel veri ya da iç kurallar

explanation.en: The message goes to the model.

text.en: What is done when the limit of tries is reached?

tr: Cevap insana ya da `needs_review` yoluna gönderilir
en: The answer is sent to a person or the `needs_review` path
The last invalid answer is used

explanation.en: Invalid data does not enter the system.

text.en: Which is the main idea of this section?

tr: Yapılı cevap katmanlı ayrıştırılır, şemaya göre doğrulanır ve sınırlı onarımla düzeltilir
en: A structured answer is parsed in layers, validated against a schema and fixed with a limited repair
Asking for JSON solves every problem

explanation.tr: Sonraki bölüm sistem mesajını ve tonu anlatıyor.
explanation.en: The next section is about the system message and tone.
